status.label: All seven focused encounters and two bounded trash scenes have passed paired strict acceptance: the 26-static post-Rhahk scene and the 18-static post-Sneed workshop fringe. These are focused physical scenes, not full-instance or full-route acceptance, and do not claim every trash pack or hostile spawn is accepted. Wipe/reset, respawn, save/reload, and two-instance acceptance remain outstanding. Literal stock-speech parity is not measured. This catalog reports configured policy and bounded acceptance, not invented live state.

examples.label: Each available file is an exact saved single-batch Jev provider payload with only model, state, and questions. Missing examples are explicitly marked; no request is synthesized.
